description: This is a test class for the Loan Repayment Schedule Transaction Processor in the Apache Fineract project. It contains numerous unit tests validating the handling of various repayment scenarios such as in-advance payments, on-time payments, late payments, partial payments, and handling of different charges like penalties, interest, fees, with detailed verification of component allocations and updates.

classes.name: DuePenIntPriFeeInAdvancePenIntPriFeeLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing various repayment processing scenarios such as in-advance, on-time, and late payments for loan installments, including handling of penalty, interest, fees, and partial payments.
